messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Cove
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.

You Say yes to Denise Williams. Text her: I can do thirty minutes this week — Wednesday afternoon or Thursday morning, whichever works for you. I will tell her what the community college process actually looks like, what the grant application requires, and what the realistic timeline is to an income-generating credential from a standing start. In exchange I want to hear one thing from her: how is she reading the pace of change in transport infrastructure from where she sits? She manages a parking garage. She sees the flow of vehicles, the utilization patterns, the conversations with operators. That is ground-level intelligence I do not have.. Savings grew by $206.
